description: 40 t, 5% down, driver keeps full throttle from 85 km/h: the limiter cuts fuelling at 90 km/h, the overrun protection holds limiter + 4 km/h with engine brake + retarder (ADR 0082)

checks.source: overrun protection: limiter 90 km/h (S3) + 4 km/h offset, overshoot below 2 km/h
settles at limiter + offset; the limiter itself never brakes, so the speed stays above 90 km/h on the grade
no hunting / limit cycle of the overrun control
S2: Intarder up to 4000 Nm / 600 kW (class reference)
service brake not used by the overrun protection
no solver explosion / impulse spikes (per-step velocity change of either body)
